US to Cancel Obamacare for 760,000 Over Alleged Fraud

The Trump administration announced it will cancel Obamacare coverage for 760,000 enrollees, citing alleged fraud. This action is expected to save $2.2 billion. The administration is blaming fraud for the cancellations.
